title: Strict Concurrency Explicit Flag
requirements: Pin strict concurrency explicitly in Package.swift: add an inline comment next to .swiftLanguageMode(.v6) confirming it enforces strict concurrency for the toolchain, or add .unsafeFlags(["-strict-concurrency=complete"]) if .v6 alone is insufficient for an older toolchain
Run `swift build` and confirm zero concurrency-related warnings
Document the choice in specs/decisions.md or a top-of-file comment so intent is explicit and future-proof against toolchain drift
acceptance_criteria: swift build produces no concurrency warnings
The strict-concurrency intent is clearly documented in Package.swift or specs/decisions.md
